name: mac-gestures
description: MacGestures — macOS menu-bar app: camera hand gestures trigger AppleScript/shell scripts, with a self-describing HTTP CLI for agents

changes: Agent guide page simplified to match the protocol's spirit: a single Base URL entry point; agents discover every command, parameter and example progressively via ?help=1 instead of reading pre-written command listings
All 8 gestures now ship with a working default action: a macOS notification (with sound) reporting the recognized gesture, enabled out of the box
Fresh installs trigger a visible notification for every recognized gesture without any configuration; existing configs are untouched
Initial release: menu-bar app recognizing 8 hand gestures via Apple Vision (fully on-device) and running AppleScript/shell scripts per gesture
Local HTTP CLI (http-cli-for-agent v1.0.0 protocol) at http://127.0.0.1:8741/cli for agents to configure gestures with progressive ?help=1 discovery
Settings window: gesture list with icons, script editor, test-run button, and a built-in agent integration guide
Tray shows the currently recognized gesture; menu offers start/pause recognition and settings
GitHub Release pipeline: tag-triggered ad-hoc signed DMG via GitHub Actions
